descriptions.inProgress: The Knighthood Exam has started. The test itself is actually quite simple. I just need to reach the end of the Training Forest, enter #bthe 2nd Drill Hall#k, and defeat the Mimis inside while bringing back #t4032099#. I better find #b30 #t4032099#s#k and bring them back to #p1101006#. \n\n#i4032099# #t4032099# #b#c4032099# / 30#k
descriptions.completed: I have successfully completed the Knighthood Exam and officially dropped the "in-Training" from my title. As a bonafide Cygnus Knight, I shall do my best to become one of pure darkness without a hint of evil.
